public_benchmark.native_study_future_seeds: all NEW and preregistered before new native first-use; do not re-score K4R consumed DEV as native source

readiness_criteria: exact original K4R source provenance and qualified outcome cryptographically authenticated
original independent native code commit and Git blob identity verified
authentic callable native policy can choose 0,1,2 based on PUBLIC MiniGrid current observation (not expert BFS, variant/seed, reward oracle)
native update accepts genuine same public pre-action observation, selected legal action, and post-action consequence from matched FIT experiences
native snapshot/restore of learned state across process restart possible
independent implementations, no Wingless/Yggdrasil weight sharing or emulation
same legal action/observation/experience interface available to matched conventional baselines
no new CHECK or DEV task consumed until complete K4S source readiness
proof_method: Run original read-only K4R artifact custody and source-pinned Wingless and Yggdrasil native entrypoint inspection and callable validity checks. Do not fake a third action by mapping it to binary, treat public next-bit forecaster as action policy, or classify successful conventional BFS as a native learner. If any candidate cannot select all three legitimate navigation actions, report native interface not ready and do not evaluate/reuse K4R DEV.
classification_policy: SOURCE_COMPATIBLE_NATIVE_STUDY_READY requires all criteria on independent native candidates; else NATIVE_POLICY_INTERFACE_NOT_READY, with exact blocker per candidate. Engineering PASS is independent of scientific result.
